notes.title: Update: Oculus Touch Support!
notes.content:
Better late than never?

Just in time for the holidays, Oculus Touch is now supported in Kindled Cavern. Previously, the game used an interaction system specific to the HTC Vive controllers. But now, all OpenVR controllers should be compatible - although only Oculus Touch has been tested. (If someone with Windows MR wants to try it out, let me know how it works!) Keep in mind you will need 360-degree tracking to play.

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Update: "Blink" Teleport option added
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442163/85c3977f7b7331c9d4daadc56f87a1917e48e42c.png[/img]

Hello!

We've gotten a lot of great feedback since the game has come out. One of the biggest issues that was brought up is that the Slide/Dash Teleport style could be potentially nauseating for some people.

Well now you have the option! After entering the cave, you can choose between a "Blink" (where the screen fades to black while teleporting) or a "Slide" (where the playspace is translated to the selected position). I hope this makes the game more accesible to those who suffer from motion sickness.

As always, let us know if you encounter any bugs or issues. We can't fix it if we don't know about it!

notes.title: Update: Minor Tweaks and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We've gotten some great feedback over the past day, and we've noticed a couple of small things that could be quickly fixed to improve the experience.

Changelog:
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug where the splash sound effect was played more than once for one waterfall.
    [*]Improved teleportable bounds. Some areas are easier to teleport to now.
    [*]Made the entrance to one of the areas more apparent.
    [*]Slightly clarified some instructions.
    [*]Added an extra torch to a key area.
[/list]

notes.title: Kindled Cavern is now available!
notes.content:
Get ready to explore!

Kindled Cavern has now launched. We are excited to hear what everyone thinks of it. So please let us know what you think in the Community Hub.

There are a number of secrets hidden around the map that you probably won't find on your first playthrough. Keep exploring and you'll find them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442163/e0dfaca86af8da096ebc74124d0aae3b21fcac88.png[/img]

If you experience any technical issues, please post about it in the discussion forum, or email us at PrettyOkayGames@tutanota.com
